intended_consumer: DvirOS authenticated server-side study workspace (not implemented here)
accepted_artifacts: 2–6 complete, independently HMAC-verifiable v0.10.0 study preview JSON envelopes
ordered_input: --packet may be repeated 2 to 6 times; local captured_at_unix must strictly increase
scope: one directed canonical Work ID pair; each v0.9.11 bounded two-pass audit <=100 links
verification: Re-verify every original sealed preview and recompute every v0.10.2 diff and SHA-256 chain link; verify v0.10.3 domain-separated HMAC
outputs: one owner-only private create-only JSON receipt, max 250 KB, no writes to database or cloud
interpretation: SHA-256 chain and HMAC demonstrate integrity against local token, not independent timestamp authority
A->B->A row-state revisits detect intermediate observed changes despite identical first/last row states
Only selected Work-pair audit windows are compared, not full graph revisions
No reviewer approval, rights clearance, licensed quotations or immutable snapshots are inferred
consumer_responsibilities: retain original ordered source packets for replay
store human decisions separately in DvirOS Postgres
treat metadata drift as review-needed, never an automatic approval
require human assessment for selection-only changes even without audit row drift
